content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 2.1, p0012)** — redline validated and submitted.

- **Issue:** § 2.1 binds us to a three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" — the rule's walk-away scenario, and materially worse than the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty).
- **Internal conflict supporting removal:** § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge we made *no* minimum-volume commitment, § 7.1 bars undisclosed minimum-use charges, and § 9.4 gives us 30-day convenience termination with refund of prepaid Fees — so the rest of the bargain is a no-minimum deal, making the preferred position proportionate.
- **Edit:** replaced the commitment with "Customer has no minimum purchase commitment. Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term," consistent with precedent seed-mincommit, and the 12-month/true-up fallback is offered in the comment.
